title: POTV Lobo Starter Accessories Kit
description:
Who is the “Starter” Accessories Kit for?

The POTV Lobo Starter Bundle is for any user who wants to dip their toes into the world of POTV Lobo accessories but isn’t sure where to start. This bundle sets you off on the right path with all the accessories you need to upgrade your Lobo vaporizer experience, with room to expand if you wish.

Each accessory enhances every stage of your session, from grinding, packing, and loading to cleaning and maintenance.

Looking for a little more? Check out our Advanced Bundle.

POTV Globe Glass stem

Enjoy the coolest vapor from a dry stem with the enhanced cooling power of our POTV Globe Glass stem. Longer hits and higher temperatures can get uncomfortable. That’s what this stem is for.

Its bulbous “globe,” cooling dimples, and extended vapor path add an extra layer of vapor-conditioning, plus more open airflow compared to the standard Dimpled Stem.

POTV GrindVac Container

Vaporizers perform best with ground herbs, and herbs are smelly. The POTV GrindVac Container combines a grinder and airtight storage in one convenient solution.

Grind your herbs directly into the sealed, smell-proof compartment to keep your stash fresh and discreet. The container secures your herbs with a built-in lock and includes a hidden stir tool for stirring or scraping.

Set of 4 POTV Lobo Dosing Capsules

Preload these Lobo Dosing Capsules with herbs, then drop them into your vaporizer’s oven for quick, mess-free sessions. These capsules are great for chaining multiple sessions together with minimal downtime and, with your herbs conveniently contained inside, help keep your vape cleaner for longer.

POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy

Carry your preloaded sessions wherever you go with the POTV Lobo Dosing Caddy! This durable, metallic caddy securely holds up to four POTV Lobo dosing capsules and protects them with a smell-proof and water-proof seal. Pack your capsules, pop them in the caddy, and attach it to your keychain, belt loop, or bag using the included keychain ring for easy travel.

POTV Lobo Replacement Battery

Skip the charge times and never miss a puff with a spare POTV Lobo Battery. This is an exact replacement for the Lobo and is a must-have accessory to keep the sessions rolling. When it’s time to recharge, simply unscrew the battery lid on the bottom, swap in the fresh battery, and jump right back into your session.

To keep your extra battery/batteries charged, we recommend using an external charger. If you don’t have one, they are available here.

POTV Lobo Replacement Screens and Alcohol Swabs

Keep your Lobo in prime condition with a set of Lobo replacement screens. These screens sit underneath the glass adapter to prevent herbs from entering the mouthpiece and will collect debris over time. Skip the deep cleanings with a quick swap and keep your Lobo performing at its best.

Use the Snaps prefilled cotton swaps to deep clean a messy Lobo oven chamber. Hold the end with the blue line up, snap it to release the alcohol to the other end, and swab away any tough residue.

Cleaning Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild grease-cutting dishwashing detergent such as Dawn or isopropyl alcohol.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories returned on their own. However, your items are eligible for return through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.
